title: Data and analysis code for "Defining the applicability domain of AI-based affinity prediction using experimentally standardized membrane-protein benchmarks"
description: Target-level aggregate data and analysis code supporting the manuscript "Defining the applicability domain of AI-based affinity prediction using experimentally standardized membrane-protein benchmarks". The archive contains per-target screening outcomes and fold classifications for 296 G protein-coupled receptors and 296 solute carrier transporters, per-target virtual-screening metrics and predicted-score distribution statistics for the 43 targets with complete compound-level binding data, structural descriptors, and the scripts that regenerate every reported statistic from these files. Per-compound data are not included and are not required to reproduce any reported result. Code is released under the MIT License; data are released under CC BY 4.0.
